setup: Put a block or plate under the bar
Set the bar at upper-chest height
Bar on your upper back, balls of feet on the block
Set the stops just below your bottom position
execution: Let your heels sink for a stretch
Rise as high as you can and pause
Knees soft and still the whole time
faults: Don't bounce out of the bottom
Don't bend your knees to help

notes: Set the machine's safety stops just below the lowest bar position so the bar can't come down further if your feet slip.
Use a stable, non-slip block. Check your feet are set before you unhook the bar.
Smith bars differ in weight and some are counterbalanced. Log the plates added; numbers aren't comparable between gyms or with a free bar.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Calf raise (bodyweight)
regressions.reason: Learn the full range with no bar.

progressions.name: Single-leg Smith calf raise
progressions.reason: One leg at a time under the bar; much harder at the same load.

progressions.name: Longer pause at the top and bottom
progressions.reason: Removes bounce and makes a lighter load harder.

substitutions.name: Standing calf raise (machine)
substitutions.reason: Same straight-knee raise on a dedicated machine.

substitutions.name: Standing barbell calf raise
substitutions.reason: Free bar in a rack; more balance demand.

substitutions.name: Seated calf raise
substitutions.reason: Bent knees shift more work to the lower calf (soleus).

substitutions.name: Leg-press calf raise
substitutions.reason: Calves only with the back supported.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at knee-to-hip height so the ankle and the heel dropping below the block are clear. Smith frame drawn lightly; bar end-on on the upper back.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall under the bar, knees soft. Balls of the feet on the edge of a block, heels below it for a calf stretch.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Heels as high as possible, weight over the balls of the feet. The bar rises straight up on its track.

guideBrief.barPath: Vertical, fixed by the Smith track
emphasise: Heels drop below the block, then rise high
Pauses at the top and at the stretch
